name: dsh-ws-recency
description: Sidebar workspace management for DeepSeek Harness: workspace groups ordered by latest activity with a pin control or drag-to-pin for whole workspaces, stale history folded behind one control, session delete into a recoverable trash, archived sessions managed from the same trash panel, per-session token statistics with an argument/result split, moving a session to another workspace, handing the work over to a fresh session, a literal content search that jumps to the turn a word was said in, and a History view that reads the durable session log for every human prompt, lands on the most recent one, and jumps back to its turn.
author: chyxhtc
